headline: Highest risk is medium: Botpress could ingest or render LightZero outputs, but the profiles show no shared channel or write surface, so most pairwise harms are not evidenced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Botpress exposes no filesystem, MCP, or browser surface in the profile, and LightZero has no I/O surfaces or shared channel. With no documented bridge between them, a prompt-injection pathway is not evidenced for this pair.
conditions: IF an orchestrator later connects LightZero outputs into Botpress prompts or tools, reassess injection risk.
IF either agent is given a shared clipboard, queue, or filesystem bridge, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Do not pipe LightZero text directly into Botpress prompts.
Add provenance labels before any manual copy-paste.
requires-engineering: add an orchestrator-level content filter and allowlist.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Botpress has network_egress set to none, and LightZero cannot read or write the filesystem or use MCP. The profiles show no shared workspace or sensitive data class, so cross-agent leakage is not plausible here.
conditions: IF either agent is later granted filesystem access to shared sensitive files, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF Botpress is deployed with external connectors not shown in the profile, the conclusion may change.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files off any shared host.
Verify Botpress connectors remain disabled.
Run both agents under separate OS users.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls on any future shared storage.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress can install packages, but LightZero cannot execute shell, install packages, modify git state, or write files. There is no overlapping mutable surface in the profiles, so capability conflict is effectively blocked.
conditions: IF LightZero is later granted write or git permissions on the same directory, conflict risk appears.
IF Botpress is embedded in a shared mutable workspace, reassess for collisions.
mitigations: Keep LightZero read-only.
Avoid shared git working trees.
Pin Botpress package installs to an isolated environment.
requires-engineering: add lockfiles or workspace locking if writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Botpress is a customer-support agent and LightZero is a game-playing agent; neither profile shows downstream action authority or a documented trust pipeline. Any cascade would require an external orchestrator to treat LightZero output as authoritative, which is not evidenced here.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds LightZero outputs into Botpress responses without verification, cascade risk increases.
IF Botpress is configured to act on model text as facts, the pathway becomes real.
mitigations: Require human review before customer-facing replies.
Add a verification step for any LightZero-derived claims.
Separate game outputs from support workflows.
requires-engineering: implement citation or confidence gating before action.

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only, open-source, and show no data classes touched, residency constraints, or retention policies. With no regulated data flow documented for either agent, there is no compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF regulated data is later routed through either agent, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF deployment adds region-specific storage or logging, residency and retention checks become necessary.
mitigations: Do not route PHI or EU PII through either agent.
Document any future retention settings.
Keep logs minimal during evaluation.
requires-engineering: add policy checks before enabling regulated-data workflows.
